title: Fact check: Could Trump replace Canada's potash with Belarus?
description: Canada produces more potash than any other country in the world, all from 10 active mines in Saskatchewan. U.S. President Donald Trump says he's working on a deal to buy potash from Belarus at a cheaper price. But could Belarus replace our supply? Here are the facts.
text:
Canada produces more potash than any other country in the world, all from 10 active mines in Saskatchewan. U.S. President Donald Trump says he's working on a deal to buy potash from Belarus at a cheaper price.

But could Belarus replace our supply? Here are the facts.
speech_text:
Fact check: Could Trump replace Canada's potash with Belarus?

Canada produces more potash than any other country in the world, all from 10 active mines in Saskatchewan. U.S. President Donald Trump says he's working on a deal to buy potash from Belarus at a cheaper price.

But could Belarus replace our supply? Here are the facts.
